author_wait_evidence.body:
All three inline comments are blocking and must be addressed before merging. They cover DEVMODE input consistency, Settings capability synchronization, and hardware-default refresh-rate handling.

Validation on 96b1aeb7: x64 Debug builds for Power Display, Settings UI, and the relevant test projects succeeded. All 350 PowerDisplay library tests and 66 related Settings tests passed. These tests do not cover the display-mode transition and driver-specific edge cases discussed below.
